summary: Nora can copy a file somebody shared a link to onto her computer, to compute on it there.
details: file_fetch takes to="computer": the file is fetched fresh from the source and written into her computer's inbox/, a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides deck as docx, xlsx or pptx.
The copy is a snapshot: its answer gives the file's last-modified time, and a later copy fetches again. Nothing is cached in Nora.
Her Google sign-in never enters the computer; only the file's bytes do. The copy uses the same size limit, lease and audit as computer_import.
limitations: Inert until [external_files] and [computer] are both on (S5).
file_fetch is now declared an act rather than a read, so no Dreamer pass can be granted it.
The routing case for the copy is written and not yet run.
